# uds_oci_artifact (Data Source)

Fetches content from an OCI artifact stored in a container registry.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reference` (String) OCI reference to the artifact (e.g., `oci://registry.example.com/repo:tag`).

### Optional

- `file` (String) Name of a specific file within the artifact to fetch. Matched against the `org.opencontainers.image.title` layer annotation. If not specified, the first layer is returned.
- `media_type` (String) Filter layers by media type. If specified, only layers matching this media type are considered.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The fetched artifact content as a string.
- `digest` (String) The digest of the fetched content.
- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
